URVASHI RAUTELA CANNES 2026 LOOKS: FROM DRAMATIC COUTURE GOWNS TO VIRAL SAREE GLAM, ACTOR DOMINATES RED CARPET CONVERSATIONS
May 18, 2026

Rishika Singh

Urvashi Rautela has made Cannes 2026 impossible to ignore, with three very different looks that kept her firmly in the frame. From a crystal-heavy gown to a pearl-drenched silhouette and a saree that set off online comparisons, her red-carpet run has delivered plenty of conversation.

Urvashi Rautela Cannes 2026 look 1

Urvashi chose a Vietnamese couture gown covered in crystal detailing, sheer layers and a striking bird-motif headpiece. The fitted silhouette and cape-style sleeves gave the ensemble a dramatic finish, while the sparkling earrings added to the theatrical feel.

Urvashi Rautela Cannes 2026 Look 2

Her second Cannes outing was a pearl-embellished nude gown that leaned into full red-carpet glamour.

Urvashi Rautela Cannes 2026 Look 2 styling

The halter-neck design, crystal crown clutch and vintage-inspired makeup gave the look a regal, polished finish.

Urvashi Rautela Cannes 2026 Look 2 accessories

The crown-shaped Judith Leiber clutch stood out as the boldest detail, bringing a playful royal touch to the ensemble.

Urvashi Rautela Cannes 2026 Look 3

Her ivory-and-gold saree look became the most talked-about of the three after social media users drew comparisons with Gigi Hadid’s NMACC appearance.

Urvashi Rautela Cannes 2026 Look 3 reactions

The styling may have split opinion online, but it also ensured that Urvashi remained one of the most visible Indian names at Cannes.

Urvashi’s Cannes run this year has followed the same pattern as her earlier appearances, bold, attention-grabbing and designed to be remembered. Whether admired or debated, each look has kept her in the middle of the fashion conversation.
